contents.description: Provides rich language support untuk HTML dan Handlebar berkas
contents.html.customData.desc:
Daftar relative berkas paths pointing to JSON berkas following the [custom data format](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-html-languageservice/blob/master/docs/customData.md).

VS Code loads custom data on startup to enhance its HTML support untuk the custom HTML tags, attributes dan attribute values you specify in the JSON berkas.

The berkas paths are relative to ruang kerja dan only ruang kerja folder pengaturan are considered.
contents.html.format.wrapLineLength.desc: Maximum amount of characters per line (0 = nonaktifkan).
contents.html.format.unformatted.desc: Daftar tags, comma separated, that shouldn't be reformatted. `null` defaults to all tags listed at https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/dom.html#phrasing-content.
contents.html.format.contentUnformatted.desc: Daftar tags, comma separated, where the content shouldn't be reformatted. `null` defaults to the `pre` tag.
contents.html.format.preserveNewLines.desc: Mengontrol apakah existing line breaks before elements should be preserved. Only works before elements, not inside tags atau untuk text.
contents.html.format.maxPreserveNewLines.desc: Maximum number of line breaks to be preserved in one chunk. Use `null` untuk unlimited.
contents.html.format.extraLiners.desc: Daftar tags, comma separated, that should have an extra newline before them. `null` defaults to `"head, body, /html"`.
contents.html.format.wrapAttributes.auto: Wrap attributes only when line length is exceeded.
contents.html.format.wrapAttributes.forcealign: Wrap each attribute except first dan keep aligned.
contents.html.format.wrapAttributes.alignedmultip: Wrap when line length is exceeded, align attributes vertically.
contents.html.format.wrapAttributes.preservealign: Preserve wrapping of attributes but align.
contents.html.format.templating.desc: Honor django, erb, handlebars dan php templating language tags.
Keep text content together between this string.
contents.html.format.wrapAttributesIndentSize.des: Indent wrapped attributes to after N characters. Use `null` to use the bawaan indent size. Ignored if `#html.format.wrapAttributes#` is set to `aligned`.
contents.html.suggest.html5.desc: Mengontrol apakah the built-in HTML language support suggests HTML5 tags, properties dan values.
contents.html.suggest.hideEndTagSuggestions.desc: Mengontrol apakah the built-in HTML language support suggests menutup tags. When dinonaktifkan, end tag completions like `` will not be ditampilkan.
contents.html.trace.server.desc: Traces the communication between VS Code dan the HTML language server.
contents.html.validate.scripts: Mengontrol apakah the built-in HTML language support validates embedded scripts.
contents.html.validate.styles: Mengontrol apakah the built-in HTML language support validates embedded styles.
contents.html.autoCreateQuotes: Aktifkan/nonaktifkan auto creation of quotes untuk HTML attribute assignment. The type of quotes can be dikonfigurasi oleh `#html.completion.attributeDefaultValue#`.
contents.html.completion.attributeDefaultValue: Mengontrol bawaan value untuk attributes when completion is accepted.
contents.html.hover.documentation: tampilkan tag dan attribute documentation in hover.
contents.html.hover.references: tampilkan references to MDN in hover.
